purpose: Conformance-validate a structured e-invoice extract against version-pinned Factur-X, XRechnung, PINT-AE, MyInvois, Peppol BIS 3.0/EN 16931 core (Belgium), or KSeF FA(3) (Poland) format rules: mandatory-field presence, currency/VAT-category codelist membership, line-item cardinality. Returns per-rule findings, missing_fields, and structural_completeness. Root node of the einvoice-validation-pipeline chain. Zero network, zero PII. Not a legal-validity determination.
